query: INSERT INTO intel_snapshot (digest, taken_at, streams) SELECT $1, $2::text::timestamptz, COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(e.key, e.value), '{}') FROM intel_source s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(s.streams) e ON CONFLICT (digest) DO UPDATE SET taken_at = EXCLUDED.taken_at, streams = EXCLUDED.streams
